title: Swift 1.5 Qwen3.8-Flash-Next NVFP4 on four Sparks
evidence_scope: Revision 3ff0520224f264a2d0ac4ab56ece8f2f13aadb38 of ukisai/Swift-1.5-Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-NVFP4 with the qwen38-flash-next-qad-tp4 settings for the same Qwen4Exp architecture, except where this checkpoint's format differs: ModelOpt NVFP4 routed experts (--quantization modelopt_fp4), the BF16 PLE n-gram table resident in GPU memory (VLLM_PLE_CPU_OFFLOAD=0, 23.8 GiB per rank), and BF16 MTP draft experts on vLLM's unquantized MoE kernel, on installer image dev-20260927-h2dstaging-cuda1342-nccl2323-status031. No GB10 serving run covers this profile; CPU configuration, rendering and checkpoint-pin checks only. Image dev-20260927-b12xcache-cuda1342-nccl2323-status032 is dev-20260927-h2dstaging-cuda1342-nccl2323-status031 with a B12X selection-cache correction, so starts on several Sparks reuse the kernel tuning the ranks have already agreed on, and runtime-status 0.3.2, whose dashboard shows the served model name; the evidence above was measured on dev-20260927-h2dstaging-cuda1342-nccl2323-status031. This profile runs image dev-20260927-mimovision-cuda1342-nccl2323-status032, which is dev-20260927-b12xcache-cuda1342-nccl2323-status032 with the MiMo vision encoder's attention sinks applied in the softmax denominator.
